name: mentari-smart-parenting
description: MentariSmartParent — Parenting Knowledge Hub by Mentari Group. Monorepo: apps/web (Next.js) + apps/api (NestJS) + packages/shared + packages/database.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter=@mentari/shared --filter=@mentari/database build && pnpm --filter=@mentari/api build && pnpm --filter=@mentari/web build
scripts.db:setup: pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:push && pnpm db:seed
